title: Magazine style editorial layout
when: The user wants a news, magazine or editorial front page with a lead story, secondary stories and headline lists.
inputs: stories with title, summary, section and date
prompt:
Goal: A 12 column editorial grid with lead, secondary and tertiary tiers that collapses to one readable column on phones.
Steps:
1. From about 60em use grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); one column below.
2. Lead story spans 8 columns with a large image and a two line dek; a side rail spans 4 with three headline only items.
3. Second row: three stories of 4 columns with a smaller image, a kicker (section name) and byline.
4. Separate tiers with thin rules (border-block-start: 1px solid var(--color-border)) and type size, not boxes.
5. Write each story as an article with a heading link, a time element with datetime, and a short summary.
6. Use a serif for headlines and one body size; vary only size and weight by tier.
Quality bar:
- Three visible levels of importance.
- Headline links carry the full title.
- Columns align to shared grid lines.
Pitfalls:
- Every story the same size, which hides the lead.
- CSS multi column text that forces zigzag reading.
- Headlines cut with ellipsis.
Verify:
- [ ] 12 minmax(0, 1fr) tracks.
- [ ] Each story is an article with a heading link.
- [ ] time elements carry datetime.
- [ ] Single column at 375 px.
Output: index.html with the story tiers and the editorial grid in style.css.

examples.input: front page for a neighborhood news site
examples.output: lead story 8 columns with rail of 3 headlines, then 3 stories of 4 columns, serif headlines
